newsitem.title: USA: Savannah Food says merger to dilute earnings.
newsitem.headline: Savannah Food says merger to dilute earnings.

text.p: Savannah Foods & Industries Inc said on Thursday said its previously announced proposed merger with Florida Crystals Inc would initially dilute earnings in the year ending September 30, 1998.
The company said in a press release, however, that it believes the combination would result in a strong, efficient, and competitive sugar company.
Savannah Foods said the merged company would have current annual revenues on a pro-forma basis of approximately $1.5 billion and assets in excess of $1 billion.
Florida Crystals is a major raw sugar producer that farms approximately 180,000 acres in South Florida, of which it owns approximately 153,000 acres.
Savannah Foods, a sugar processor, sells refined cane and beet sugar in the Eastern United States and also provides grocery storage and distribution services.
